items.description: Adds the `branch-number` and `ticket-ref` commands to `thor-git`, ported from `tb-git` in `@williamthorsen/toolbelt.git` with the same flags, output, and exit codes, which derive a stable number from a branch name and print the ticket that a branch name encodes, reading the checked-out branch when no branch is given. (#529)

Adds the `@williamthorsen/git-tools` package with a `thor-git` binary, which prints its help for `--help`, `-h`, or no arguments and exits with code 2 on any other argument, to hold the `tb-git` port in #517. (#524)
